- [LSTO.9.8] **Drop-oldest is engine-enforced via
  metric+log on cb failure.** Sample-emission cb returning
  a non-OK status (or being NULL) drops the sample, emits
  the `ds.samples.dropped_total` counter, and proceeds —
  rules see DS_OK regardless. Author-facing drop-oldest
  semantics are preserved; operator-facing observability
  comes from the metric. Integrator wiring at
  [NSTG.5.6].
gap_reason: Deferred with the samples plane and its sample callback, which this edition does not bind; there is no sample emission for a vector to fail. Its vector stays deprecated.
